en: "I'm not telllling~"{w}
"How meeean~ I want just a hint, at leeeast~"{w}
"Nooo, you can't~"{w}
"Hey! Quit fooling around and come out, will you!?"{w}
"Ufufuuu~~~~"{w}
note: ~~~ for the source's drawn-out tilde run; the final ~ is the source's note mark per convention.

en: "Graaanny, yoo-hooo~"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Granny', as the Elderly Adventurer calls the old woman (possibly his wife; not stated).

en: "...That damn old hag! What if other adventurers get ahead of us while we're dawdling around!?"{w}{p}"It's definitely somewhere around here. The voice came from the east, so..."{w}
note: The Nun's [JP] kept at full strength ('damn old hag'), as slice 019 rendered [JP].

en: Bistel Magic Bureau Officer
note: Glossary form; 27 chars, over the ~16 name-box guide. Shorter fallback if it does not fit: 'Magic Bureau Officer'.

en: "I am an officer of the Bistel Magic Bureau. By order of Director Archelon, this place is sealed off."{w}{p}"Unless you're adventurers who can at least find the Jewel Ring, you'd die the moment you went in. Get yourselves in order and come back another time."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'Director Archelon' (glossary title [JP] = Director Archelon); no Lord/Master since Archelon's gender is not established.

en: "Mm, that compass is proof you passed the trial! You did well!{w}But don't go getting carried away, eh?"{w}{p}"Truth is, B1F is protected by Director Archelon's power, the same as Bistel."{w}{p}"But beyond here, it's different. From B2F on, things are out of our hands. If you don't keep your wits about you, you'll be dead in a ditch in no time."{w}{p}"Now then, off you go!"{w}
Samurai
"Curse you, Abizaemon! Heaping shame on a samurai like meeee!"{w}
note: [JP] romanized 'Abizaemon' (mock samurai name built on the Abi of the glossary; new name).

en: "Calm down, old man! ...Jeez, if I hadn't jumped in to help, it wouldn't have stopped at a little shame, y'know?"{w}
note: [JP] = 'old man' (the Thief's address; the Samurai is 74+ years into his bushido).

en: "I only challenged it because I heard it was weak!!"{w}
"And you call yourself a samurai..."{w}
"The second I came to, none of my attacks would land -- what is the meaning of thiiiiiis!!"{w}
note: [JP] read as waking from a sleep/KO status in the fight.

en: "'Cause your skills are garbage, old man! Man, though, that's the first time I've seen anyone near master level almost lose to an Abi."{w}
note: [JP] = 'garbage' (crude, matches the Thief's tone); [JP] -> lowercase 'master level' (class mastery level).
[JP] = slurred, childish 'shut up'. Source line breaks kept as \n because the three beats are separate sobs; can be dropped if wrap is preferred.

en: "Oh, come ON! Quit crying, it's embarrassing at your age!!"{w}
"But... but, I... I found the Helm Splitter... and I still haven't won even once... It's seppuku for meeee! Seppuku-puuuu!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Helm Splitter' (plain translation; new item name). [JP] is a babyish mangling of seppuku, kept as 'Seppuku-puuuu'.

en: "Okay, okay! Then next time I'll go with you!"{w}
"R-Really!?"{w}
"Yeah, I'll tag along, since there's no helping it! ...Jeez."{w}
"Heh... Fwahahaha! Allll riiiight!!{w}Just you wait, Abizaemon! I'll hack you in two with this Helm Splitter!"{w}
"What a pain..."{w}
Suddenly, you felt a strange, heavy pressure.{w}The source of that oppressive presence was a force holding back the casting of spells.{w}
You no longer feel the strange pressure.{w}
A giant bat appeared before you.{w}
A giant bat appeared before you.{w}Could this be the bat from the request?{w}
The strange pressure has not gone away, so you will have to fight without being able to use spells.{w}
You routed the Big Vanbat.{w}
note: [JP] romanized 'Big Vanbat' (new monster name; could be meant as 'Vambat'/vampire bat - check the monster table).

en: A giant bat lies sprawled at your feet.{w}You succeeded in exterminating the Big Vanbat.{w}
No one is here now.{w}
Suddenly, a sweet smell filled the air.{w}A fierce drowsiness comes over you. Going on like this might be dangerous.{w}
You no longer smell the sweet scent.{w}
The sweet smell has not faded, so you will have to fight off drowsiness as well.{w}

Suddenly, your sight was stolen from you.{w}In the darkness, the clammy air peculiar to caves clings to you.{w}{p}A monster by the name of fear slowly began to raise its head, ready to devour your weakened hearts.{w}
You no longer feel fear.{w}
The darkness has not lifted, so you will have to fight fear as well.{w}
You sensed a change in the air around you.{w}When you breathe in, your insides clench painfully.{w}{p}It seems air laden with toxins is drifting in.{w}
You no longer sense the miasma.{w}
note: [JP] = 'miasma' (the event's [JP] = 'toxins').

en: The miasma has not cleared, so you will have to fight the toxins as well.{w}

Suddenly, the strength drains from your knees.{w}You nearly sank to the ground, but held on.{w}This does not seem to be anyone's prank.{w}{p}The strange weakness grows stronger with every step you take.{w}
You no longer feel the weakness.{w}
The strange weakness has not gone away, so you will have to fight in the worst possible condition.{w}
There is a sign.{w}
note: [JP] in a dungeon = 'sign' (the Bistel plaza one was 'notice board').
Bordered sign drawn with full-width asterisks; redrawn as ASCII '*' with padded lines of equal length (41 chars). Centring depends on the font - check in game.

en: Digging onward, you came out into a somewhat open space.{w}The cool air feels pleasant.{w}{p}Is this where you should bring Raizam?{w}

"Hm... This place is...!!{w}This rock face, this coolness, the size of this chamber!{w}It's perfect for my house, moguuu!"{w}{p}"I've decided, mogu! I'm living here, mogu!{w}You lot did well, moguuu!!"{w}
note: [JP] as Raizam's first person -> 'my/I'; [JP] = 'chamber'.

en: "Now, the first thing to do in my new home is...{w}take a nap, moguuu!{w}Well then, everyone, good night..."{w}{p}"ZZZzzz..."{w}
"...That's cold, mogu!?{w}Wh-What is it, mogu!?"{w}
When you listen closely, you hear a drip-drip of water.{w}It seems drops of water are falling from the ceiling.{w}

"A-A leak, mogu! This is a defective cave, moguuu!?{w}If freezing water like this keeps dripping on me, I'll catch a cold, mogu!!"{w}{p}"Something has to be done so I don't catch a cold, mogu!{w}At times like this... um..."{w}
note: Accuracy: [JP] is open between Raizam resolving to act and an order to the party (cf. [JP] = imperative at 4219); the scene does not settle it, so an impersonal 'Something has to be done' keeps both readings. Translator draft read it as Raizam's own resolve.

en: Raizam took out some sort of thick book and began earnestly flipping through it.{w}

"Ummm, ummm... Found it, mogu!{w}Let's see, in Gandra Mine...{w}...Okay, got it, mogu!!"{w}{p}"The girl at the general store in Gandra Mine is supposed to be good at fixing leaks and stuff, mogu!{w}I want you to bring her here, mogu!"{w}{p}"I'm counting on you, moguuu~{w}I'll sleep here while I wait, mogu...{w}ZZZzzz..."{w}
note: 'the general store in Gandra Mine' = Jera's General Store; Raizam does not name it, so kept descriptive.

en: "ZZZzzz...{w}Mmnya, mmnya..."{w}
Raizam is asleep.{w}
"This is the Earth Sage?{w}My, my... this one looks like a real klutz..."{w}
note: [JP] = 'looks like a klutz' (slow, clumsy); pronoun avoided.

en: "Raizam?{w}Yoo-hoo, Earth Saaage?"{w}
note: [JP]/[JP] carried as tone, no Mr./Ms. (gender unknown).

en: "...Mm... who's there, mogu?"{w}
"It's Jera, from Gandra Mine.{w}Thank you sooo much for asking for me by name~"{w}
note: [JP] = being requested by name (service-trade phrasing).

en: "I'd like you to get right to it, mogu. Please fix the leak in this chamber's ceiling, mogu."{w}
"I can't reach it like this.{w}Hey, Sage, could you be my step stool for a sec?"{w}
"Sure, mogu. I'll be down here sleeping, mogu.{w}Do whatever you like, moguuu."{w}
"Aaand, one job done!"{w}
"The water's not dripping anymore, mogu!{w}Well done, moguuu!!"{w}
"You're welcome!"{w}
"...What's the matter, mogu?"{w}
"Huh? What's the matter, you say...{w}You're just going to leave it at that? What about my payment?"{w}
"Ah, so that's what you mean, mogu!"{w}
"Uh-huh, uh-huh!"{w}
"There's no such thing, mogu!"{w}
"Th-There's no such thing!?"{w}
"I'm one of the Four Sages, mogu! I'm super important, mogu!!{w}If there IS a reward, it's the honor of being asked to repair my home, moguuu."{w}
"Ummm... are you serious?"{w}
"Mogu!"{w}
"Huh... is that so.{w}Making the great Jera work for free... you've got some nerve, don't you?"{w}
note: [JP] (self-reference with [JP]) -> 'the great Jera'.

en: "Aw, it's nothing special, mogu. You're making me blush, moguuu~"{w}
note: Raizam takes 'some nerve' as praise; the misunderstanding is the joke.

en: "Well then, Earth Sage.{w}Would you come over here with big sis for a bit?"{w}
note: [JP] self-reference -> 'big sis' (Jera talking down to Raizam; leads into slice 034 where she takes Raizam's whiskers).
